title: GEMv2: Multilingual NLG Benchmarking in a Single Line of Code

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language diversity and representation by categorizing dataset availability across 51 languages using a resource availability taxonomy to counteract English-centric focus in natural language generation (NLG) tasks.
Integrating dataset-agnostic bias detection filters and fairness evaluation suites into the benchmark infrastructure to automatically evaluate model outputs.
